# Demolition Boys BBQ

## About
Demolition Boys BBQ is a Central Texas barbecue smokehouse serving slow-smoked brisket, ribs, sausage, family-style sides, and catering in Mission, Texas.

## Business details
- Name: Demolition Boys BBQ
- Type: Restaurant and barbecue smokehouse
- Location: 4301 N Doffing, Mission, TX 78574
- Phone: (956) 685-4117
- Email: hello@demolitionboysbbq.com
- Hours: Monday–Sunday, 11:00 AM–9:00 PM

## Menu highlights
- Slow-smoked brisket
- Pork ribs and smoked meats
- Sausage and sides
- Family-style BBQ platters
- Catering for gatherings and events
